contract.json.scope: Single-task budget-constrained original RDT AC-DiT two-stage adaptation, not exact seven-task paper reproduction

collection.split: train plans; scene-disjoint 20 percent development before training
collection.scene_selection: Seeded cyclic coverage of all available training scenes; explicit reconfigure/build_config_idxs per batch

contract.json.selection: Fixed 16 dev observations with deterministic diffusion RNG, active-channel first-action RMSE; no native test selection
contract.json.safety: Finite loss and gradients or fail; no automatic restart; hard timeout; atomic rolling latest and best weights; fail closed before stage2 if stage1 missing
intentional_differences: bounded time, reduced effective batches relative to eight GPUs
CPU/no EMA for budget, nonEMA selected
transfer all mobility input adapters from stage1 to avoid random frozen conditioning
contract.json.budget_accounting: User resumed after VPN outage; exclude idle disconnection, conservatively debit 900 seconds for all previous preparation including failed collection and GPU preflights. Remaining single job has hard 63900-second bound. No completed training updates or training restart.

data/collection.json.source: new native official SAC demonstrations in pinned AC-DiT fork
